g.text: Confirmed: IIT requester/faculty email · external intern email allowed · no extra HoD approval
Verify who pays for each student
Review dates, hostel options & room conflicts
Faculty and CW Office decisions visible
No repeated faculty approval in the normal path
Reason is recorded; this child stops
Other students in the batch can continue
All Academics users are eligible. Only the selected faculty recommends. Group rows by student / creator / faculty / batch.
CW Office sets the offer; faculty-verified payer identity travels into payment and the invoice
CW Office issues the student offer
Confirm dates, hostel and accommodation charge
Mess: with / without; no food charge invoice
Confirm verified payer; freeze offer + bill-to snapshot
Email every intern; external email allowed
Scoped updates to creator and faculty
Show offer; upload UTR / date / screenshot
Faculty uses authorized view / secure link
Submit payment proof for this student
Keep creator, resident and payer distinct
Does not unlock rooms under current rules
One student = one bill in version one. A shared faculty transfer needs an allocation ledger; never credit it in full to every child.
Typed room assignment & live warning overrides
Any real room in authorized hostel scope can be reviewed. Occupancy warnings are advisory, not prohibitions.
Supervisor is authorized for this hostel
Use normal input — no all-room dropdown
Stay window uses approved dates and times
Invalid dates or request not ready
Current resident allocations; presence may be unknown
Overlapping H2 + legacy visitor + H4 reservations
Room status / nominal capacity / placement issues
Exclude this request; honor early/late stay times
Show who is assigned to the room
Do not infer absence from summer holidays
Current allocations have no dated absence
OR choose another room and check again
Resident / guest overlap never blocks H4
Read current conflicts immediately before saving
H2 / legacy assignments use the same room lock
Do not silently save a stale override
Actor, time, warnings and reason saved atomically
Leave resident allocation / occupancy / capacity / status
Notify intern of the room → continue to flow 04
Normal H2/legacy guest booking remains restrictive and checks H4 reservations. H4 never flips a resident room to Guest or reactivates it.
Arrival, stay changes, close-out & payer invoice
One student can arrive, extend, move, cancel or settle independently of the rest of the submission batch.
Gate and supervisor see a scoped arrival roster
Rerun conflicts over the new stay window
Room move → repeat flow 03 for new room
Scheduled stay end uses the agreed close-out
Release only the H4 dated reservation
Release does not wait for invoice generation
Resident allocation and room status remain unchanged
Outstanding money remains on the student’s request
Unique invoice number + frozen bill-to identity
Invoice raised in the intern’s name
Deliver to that intern’s permitted email / access
Invoice raised in verified faculty’s name
Deliver to faculty; creator is not the bill-to
Dining roster can be shared as authorized
No food invoice through this portal
Invoice recipient is the verified payer. Cancellation never claims an automatic refund. Payment history remains accessible after the stay ends.
